trigger.app_settings.app_settings_root_a.functionDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.harmoniarr_root_authority_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended('harmoniarr.library-request-projection', 0));
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
